name: kimi
description: Delegate isolated coding tasks from Codex to Kimi Code over ACP, then review the resulting Git checkpoints.

interface.longDescription: Use Kimi Code as a background implementation worker while Codex remains the supervisor and independent reviewer. Write jobs run in isolated Git worktrees and return compact structured handoffs instead of full transcripts.
